flash_log: UTF-16 re-encoding of the source flash log, preceded by the command line, because collector_v2.py reads flash.log as UTF-16.
flash_result: Values copied from the flash section of the source preflight record.
identification_log: Derived extract of the same esptool output, because collector_v2.py requires the board MAC in identification.log. No separate flash-id was run, as for HBPSN-09 to 12.
automatic_post_flash_boot: Setup only; excluded from the formal session by the measured-reset log boundaries.
